MARTIN:	You almost there?
DAVID: 	Yeah, getting to the door...	Anyway, it's the principle of the thing.  I’m afraid of the dark, but-
MARTIN:	Wait…You’re afraid of the dark?	
DAVID:	Yeah- and
SFX: CRASH OF LIGHTNING

CONVERSATION INTERRUPTED BY:
SFX - CRASH OF THUNDER, LOUD, SUDDEN - FOLLOWED BY A TORRENTIAL DOWNPOUR

MARTIN: 	Rain?

DAVID: 	Nuclear apocalypse, actually... Yeah, of course rain. Came outta nowhere, too. Sky was pretty clear on the drive up. Crap. Hold on, my phone's getting wet.

[SFX: DAVID RUNNING UP THE WET STONE STEPS. THE RAIN BEATS DOWN.]

MARTIN:	Shoulda stayed in LA...

SFX: DAVID CONTINUES UP THE STEPS. THE RAIN POUNDS DOWN HARDER. DAVID IS PANTING AND OUT OF BREATH AS HE GETS TO A SHELTERED AREA BY THE FRONT DOOR. AS HE FINDS SHELTER, THE SOUND OF RAIN GETS MORE DISTANT. 

DAVID : 	(out of breath)	Okay... I’m here.

MARTIN: 	You need to work out more, man! 

DAVID (CONT’D): 	Funny guy!... Anyway... I'm opening the door ... Let's hope the owner wasn't right...

MARTIN: 	Whattdya mean?

DAVID: 	When he gave me the keys, he went all Crazy Ralph on me.

MARTIN: Ah, whatever. Just get in there...
